fixes.was: a corporation operating in many places cannot be at home in all of them.
fixes.now: a corporation operating in many places cannot ordinarily be at home in all of them merely because its sales are sizable.

fixes.was: The bond requirement tested only the applicant's own confidence in the claim,
fixes.now: The bond requirement might deter an entirely baseless application but principally tested the applicant's own confidence in the claim,
